set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-organization.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Implement executed-policy readout compatibility with checked stage provenance and explicit Compatible/ModelDependent/Incompatible/Unknown results. Only reference-compatible results may feed organization; this is not a 1.0 facade prerequisite.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: compatibility; lane: next.

Scope: align measurement policy, codec stage receipts

Acceptance criteria:
1. Readout request declares quantity, source axis/order, recall organization unit, resolution and unknown-transition policy. Derived stage ledger covers candidates/rendering/scoring/context/refinement/inference/decision/projection.
2. Checked outcomes distinguish CompatibleWithDeclaredPolicy, ModelDependentOnly, Incompatible, UnknownProvenance. A hard-monotone path cannot satisfy a reference backtracking request. PriorScale=0 and Content rung do not pass automatically.
3. Round-trip preserves the decision and its reasons. Receipt omission, caller-label forgery and stage/config/provider/candidate substitution fail; old artifacts remain UnknownProvenance.
4. Strict compatibility establishes implemented policy only. Custom unverifiable scoring cannot mint reference or calibrated authority; it remains explicitly exploratory. Reconstruction summaries are still available under their own policy.

Validation: proposed MeasurementCompatibilitySuite + codec/public-consumer negative probes

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: Reuse LayerUse details without pretending its transition-only scope covers the pipeline.
